Forecast News
	

Deduplicated daily news corpus used by forecast-sim and future-sim.

	
		
	
	
		Snapshot
	


31,947,019 articles in Parquet
3,493 daily Parquet partitions
Coverage: 2016-08-26 through 2026-09-30
Snapshot published: 2026-11-27 (UTC)
Stored data size: approximately 158.9 GiB

The Parquet files contain full article text. Daily JSONL files also contain full
article text where available. March 10, 2026 is available as JSONL only.
